audit.whatIsWrong: The entire full layer is built around an ability called 'Repeating Dashes'. No such ability exists. It appears in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, three phase whys, five breakdown keys, loading, focus, two dos, ahead and five report rows.
audit.why: Ambessa's kit is Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep/Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E) and Public Execution (R). The repeating-dash mechanic the name was reaching for is the PASSIVE, Drakehound's Step — but the ability Pantheon actually has to track before committing is Public Execution: 130/115/100s, blinks 1250 to the farthest champion in a line, and suppresses on arrival.
audit.corrected: Every 'Repeating Dashes' reassigned to Public Execution (identical 16-character length, so the band is untouched), and focus.letters moved from E to R to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction of the matchup is never stated: Public Execution's suppression cancels an in-progress Aegis Assault.
audit.why: Riot's Aegis Assault text has Pantheon 'striking repeatedly' behind a shield, and the kit flags it as a channel that any CC cancels. Public Execution 'suppresses them upon her arrival'. Suppression while channelling ends the channel, so his one damage-proof button and his escape both die to the same button. The mirror audit (audits/top/ambessa__pantheon.json) already establishes this from her side; stated here from yours.
audit.corrected: Public Execution's suppress cutting the Aegis Assault channel now appears in spikes[2], mid, whys[4], breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Repudiation is described only as 'her W damage'. The brace mechanic is never mentioned, so the page cannot tell you not to feed it.
audit.why: Riot's text: she 'gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground... If she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing herself, this ability will deal increased damage.' Dumping your burst into the brace is how you lose the trade you started. _missing-interactions.json flags the same shield as absorbing your burst window.
audit.corrected: Do not spend burst into a bracing Repudiation — it slams back harder for what it ate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault is called 'point-and-click' in spikes[0], early, wants.you[0] and whys[0]. It is a 600-range dash.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them.' The mirror audit corrects the same error from Ambessa's side; both pages must say the same thing. The number that matters is 600 dash range against Cunning Sweep's 650.
audit.corrected: Shield Vault now described as a 600-range dash-stun everywhere it is characterised.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appears anywhere and no Ambessa ability is named — the coverage packet flags exactly this.
audit.why: Public Execution 130/115/100, Repudiation 18/17/16/15/14, Lacerate 13/12/11/10/9, Cunning Sweep 14/13/12/11/10 at 650 range. Against Comet Spear's 575 and Shield Vault's 600 those numbers set the whole spacing problem.
audit.corrected: Spikes and the cooldown block now carry the real names and numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ambessa is referred to as 'him'/'his' in breakdown.mid, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding and report[13].

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are yours flat out — your W is a point-and-click dash-stun, so before Ambessa has her dash-chain online she simply cannot avoid the W-Q-tap and she has no escape from it. Throw your held Q spear from max range to chip her, then look for the level-2 W all-in the instant you hit it. At level 3 it tightens up: once she has her dashes she weaves out of your follow-up and her W trades back, so don't blind-commit a W into a full-resource Ambessa — wait until you see a dash spent.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours flat out — Shield Vault dashes 600 onto her with a stun and an auto reset, so before Drakehound's Step chains she cannot avoid the W into Q tap and has no way out. Poke with Comet Spear from 575 while she farms at Cunning Sweep's 650, then all-in the instant you hit 2. Level 3 tightens: her dash weaves out of your follow-up and Repudiation braces for a bigger slam, so never blind-commit W into a full-energy Ambessa — wait for a spent dash.

edits.before: Through levels 4-5 you stay ahead: empowered-Q poke racks up and your E channels the directional block straight into her W and dash-strike, turning her combo into nothing while you keep striking. The lane flips at 6 — her ultimate plus chain-CC lets her fully commit, and your Grand Starfall is built for roaming other lanes, not winning this duel. So at 6 cash your lead by R-ing to a winning lane rather than forcing a 1v1 where her CC chain out-commits you.
edits.after: Through levels 4-5 you stay ahead: empowered Comet Spear racks up and Aegis Assault, faced at her, blanks Lacerate and the dash-strike while you keep striking — just never feed the burst into a bracing Repudiation. The lane flips at 6. Public Execution blinks 1250, suppresses, and a suppressed Pantheon cannot keep channelling his 22s E or vault out. Cash your lead with a Grand Starfall roam instead of forcing that duel.

notes: Mirror reused: audits/top/ambessa__pantheon.json. Same facts stated from Pantheon's side — Shield Vault is a 600-range dash-stun (not point-and-click), Aegis Assault is a 22s frontal channel rather than a passive, Public Execution's suppress ends that channel, and Cunning Sweep's 650 outranges Comet Spear's 575. No contradiction introduced. Kit flags mark Repudiation and Public Execution as 'grounding'; Riot's descriptions mention no grounding for either, so I did not write it — logged in unverified. The chart gives Pantheon First item and 2+ items while the prose leans Ambessa; the mirror hit the same conflict and steered the prose toward her all-physical damage stalling into armour rather than flipping a side, so I did the same to keep the two directions aligned.
